L2-0534.note: M row. The classifier use is the whole card; CEDICT's 'strip/item/clause' are the noun 条.

L2-0535.note: N row. Keeps 情况 'circumstances' separate: 条件 is a term that must be met.

L2-0536.note: Verb phrase; the classroom sense is the one an HSK 2 learner meets.

L2-0538.note: V row. 'to halt' was a synonym of the lead wasting the second slot; parking is the other everyday use.

L2-0539.note: 'to pull up' is opaque to a beginner and 停车 is overwhelmingly parking.

L2-0541.note: Adv row. The physical senses (straight, to stick out) belong to 挺 at L4.

L2-0542.note: One gloss; 'very good' overstates 挺 and collides with 很好 territory.

L2-0543.note: V/Adj row. 'to know well' is the 精通 sense, not what an HSK 2 learner meets.

meanings: to pass a test or a vote
L2-0544.note: Prep is the first official POS and CEDICT buried that sense in clause 4; keeps 经过 'to pass' free.

L2-0545.note: V/N row, so one gloss for each POS instead of two verbs.

L2-0546.note: Conj/N row; both glosses read as connectives, which is how 同时 is used.

L2-0547.note: N row; plain everyday English for the workplace relationship.

L2-0549.note: N/M row: the body part plus the livestock classifier. The L3 Adj row of 头 must take the 'first, leading' sense, not this one.

L2-0550.note: Suffix row. Says what it does; 子 already owns the bare 'noun suffix' gloss at L1.

L2-0553.note: V row. 'to cut' is the barber sense of 推头 and is wrong for HSK 2; one gloss keeps it opposite 拉.

L2-0555.note: N row. 外地 is somewhere other than where the speaker is, not a foreign country.

L2-0557.note: V row; the adjective senses (whole, complete) belong to 完全.

L2-0558.note: Names the object 完成 usually takes, so it does not read as the same answer as 完 'to finish'.

L2-0559.note: Adj/Adv row. The adverb is the commoner use and it keeps 完成 'to complete' distinct.

L2-0560.note: A parting greeting, not two. 'Good evening' is 晚上好, so dropping it prevents a wrong answer.

L2-0562.note: N row. 晚饭 already leads with 'evening meal', so 晚餐 takes the plain English word for it.

L2-0565.note: Num row. 'a great number' is the 万分 idiom, not the numeral a learner counts with.

L2-0566.note: N row. 'network' is 网络 at L4, so 网 takes the physical net and the everyday online sense.

L2-0569.note: Prep/V row. 往 marks the destination of movement; 向 keeps 'in the direction of'.

L2-0570.note: Prep row. 为了 already leads with bare 'for', so this card carries the fuller phrase.

L2-0571.note: One question word; the second CEDICT clause only restates it.

L2-0572.note: M row. Rewritten without the internal comma, which the browse row would have split into two senses.

L2-0573.note: N row. CEDICT's 'sense/feeling' clauses are marked fig. and its 'odor' clause dialect.

L2-0574.note: Intj row. The old gloss carried an internal comma that rendered as two senses; 喂 'to feed' is the L4 verb row.

L2-0576.note: V row. CEDICT leads with the literary 'to hear'; HSK 2 闻 is the nose.

L2-0578.note: N row; both senses are met constantly at this level.

L2-0583.note: N row. 西 already ships bare 'west' for the compass direction, so 西方 leads with the cultural sense; 'the Occident' is period English a beginner will not know.

L2-0585.note: N row. The 'doctor trained in...' sense is secondary and too long for a card.

meanings: to take a bath or shower
L2-0588.note: One gloss covering both, since 洗澡 does not distinguish them; 'or' avoids the comma split.

L2-0589.note: M row. The directional senses belong to 下 at L1.

L2-0590.note: Leads with the weather statement so the card is not the article-stripped twin of 雪 'snow'.

L2-0593.note: Adj row. 一样 owns 'same' at L1, so 相同 takes the stronger word.

L2-0595.note: Adj row, so the lead must be the adjective; 声音 keeps the noun 'sound'.

L2-0596.note: 想到 is something occurring to you; 想起 takes 'to recall' so the pair stay distinct.

L2-0597.note: N row, so CEDICT's verb clause 'to think of a way' cannot lead; 看法 keeps 'view'.

L2-0598.note: 记得 already owns 'to remember'; 想起 is the moment something comes back to you.

L2-0599.note: Prep/V row, one gloss per POS; 往 takes 'toward'.

L2-0600.note: N row. CEDICT's 'at the opportune moment' is the literary adverb 相机 and never means this word here.

L2-0601.note: V row; the noun senses (image, portrait) are 像 as a statue, not the HSK 2 use.

L2-0602.note: Prefix row. Describes what 小王 does rather than glossing it 'small'.

L2-0603.note: Adverbial phrase; sits opposite 大声.

L2-0610.note: Official POS is V, so the noun 'joke' cannot lead; the erhua row 笑话儿 carries the noun.

L2-0611.note: N row. CEDICT only says 'erhua form of', which is not a learner gloss.

L2-0613.note: N row. 'chest' is anatomical and wrong: 心里 is where you think and feel.

L2-0614.note: N row; plain words for how someone feels.

L2-0615.note: 'central point' is the literal reading and wrong; one gloss keeps it apart from 心里.

L2-0617.note: N row. The verb senses (to trust, to believe) are 相信 and 信心 at this level.

L2-0619.note: N row. 消息 keeps 'news' and 'message', so 信息 stays with the mass noun.

L2-0622.note: Says which kind of star, since 明星 ships 'star' for the celebrity sense.

L2-0623.note: V/N row. 'to move about' is the physical-mobility sense; 动作 keeps 'movement'.

L2-0624.note: N row. The imperial-official sense in CEDICT is historical.

L2-0626.note: N/V row and N is listed first; 名字 keeps 'name' and 姓名 'full name'.

L2-0627.note: N row; 'surname and given name' is a definition, not a card answer.

L2-0628.note: 放假 is the holiday happening to you; 休假 is the leave you take, so they stay distinct.

L2-0630.note: V row. 选择 leads with 'to select', so 选 keeps 'to choose' plus the voting sense.

L2-0632.note: N row. CEDICT's 'to wipe away (a humiliation)' is literary and was shipping as sense 2.

L2-0633.note: N row. 'countenance' is the literary 'facial expression' sense and unknown to beginners.

L2-0634.note: N/M row. 眼睛 already ships 'eyes', so this card leads with the 看一眼 classifier use and keeps the organ as sense 2.

L2-0636.note: V row covering children and animals, which is the whole HSK 2 range of 养.

L2-0637.note: N row; how something looks or how someone carries themselves.

L2-0639.note: N row. 'drug' reads as narcotics in English, so one gloss only.

L2-0640.note: N row; the two everyday English names for the shop.

L2-0642.note: N row. 'medicine in liquid form' is a definition; the compound noun is the answer.

L2-0643.note: Adv row. 或 currently ships 'maybe, perhaps', so 也许 avoids that pair; 可能 keeps 'might'.

L2-0644.note: N row, one gloss; 夜里 takes the time-of-day phrase.

L2-0645.note: N row used adverbially, which is how 夜里 appears; keeps 夜 'night' distinct.

L2-0646.note: 部分 ships bare 'part', so 一部分 says it is one share of something larger.

L2-0647.note: Adj/Adv row, one gloss for each POS; the adverb is far commoner so it leads.

L2-0648.note: Adv row for adding things up.

L2-0649.note: Adv row. The L1 row of 一会儿 leads with 'a moment', so the L2 adverb row takes the time-until and duration readings.

L2-0652.note: Adv row, one gloss; 早就 takes the 'long ago' reading.

L2-0653.note: N row used as a time word, both readings common at HSK 2.

L2-0654.note: N row; mirrors 以后 and keeps 'formerly' out of a beginner card.

L2-0655.note: N row. The quantity reading leads because that is how 30 岁以上 works.

L2-0656.note: N row used as a postposition; 'except for' is the same idea and adds nothing.

L2-0657.note: V row. Bare 'to think' is 认为 and 觉得; the whole point of 以为 is that the belief turned out wrong.

L2-0661.note: 一点儿 already ships 'a little', so the reduplicated form takes the smaller quantity.

L2-0662.note: N row; 'all one's life' reads as an adverb.

L2-0664.note: Num row. Written in words so it cannot be misread as a digit string.

L2-0667.note: Conj/Prep row, one gloss for each POS.

L2-0668.note: Adj row, weather only. CEDICT's yin-yang, electrical, feminine and anatomical senses are all wrong for HSK 2.

L2-0669.note: N row, one gloss; keeps the adjective 阴 separate.

L2-0678.note: N row. 'a copy of a film' was CEDICT's first clause and is a printing sense; 电影 keeps 'movie'.

L2-0679.note: V/N row, one gloss for each POS; 作用 keeps 'effect'.

L2-0680.note: Adv row, so the adjective 'eternal' cannot ship; 总是 keeps 'always'.

L2-0681.note: N row, kitchen and machine senses together.

L2-0683.note: Adj row, so CEDICT's noun 'close friend' cannot ride along.

L2-0684.note: V row. CEDICT only says 'erhua form of'; 空儿 keeps the noun 'spare time'.

L2-0685.note: The existential reading leads, which is how 有人 opens a sentence; 别人 keeps 'other people'.

L2-0686.note: Adv row before an adjective, usually of something unwelcome; 一点儿 keeps 'a little'.

L2-0687.note: 'meaningful' is the literal reading and misleads; 好玩儿 keeps 'fun'.

L2-0688.note: Adv row. 再 ships 'again' for what has not happened yet, so 又 marks the repeat that already did.

L2-0691.note: 本来 already leads with 'original/originally', so 原来 leads with the discovery reading a learner meets in 原来如此.

L2-0692.note: N row. 'origin' is a different idea; 理由 keeps bare 'reason' at L3.

L2-0693.note: N row, the two senses behind 院子 and 医院; 院子 keeps 'a yard'.

L2-0694.note: N row. 'chair of a board' was one clause of a long CEDICT definition and is the rarest reading.

L2-0696.note: V row. 要 and 想 already own plain wanting; 愿意 is consent.

L2-0699.note: Adv row. The paired construction is the only way 越 appears at HSK 2; 'to exceed' is 超过.

L2-0700.note: The fixed phrase, kept distinct from 越 itself.

L2-0703.note: Pron row. The northern 'I/me' use is dialect; 咱们 ships 'we, including you', so this card says it concretely.

L2-0708.note: 已经 keeps bare 'already'; 早就 adds that it happened much earlier than expected.

L2-0709.note: A set question; written as the question a speaker actually asks.

L2-0710.note: Pron row. 怎么 keeps bare 'how?'; 怎么样 asks after a state or makes a suggestion.

L2-0712.note: V row, covering 占地方 and 占百分之三十.

L2-0713.note: V row. The noun 'station' is the L1 row of 站, so this card carries only the verb.

L2-0714.note: 站住 is the shouted 'stop moving', distinct from 停 'to stop'; the fig. and tenable senses are wrong for HSK 2.
